sections.faq:
Do I need an API key for text to speech?

No. You get 10,000 free characters automatically. When they are used, connect your ElevenLabs key or upgrade to PRO.

Is the text to speech player WCAG compliant?

Yes. All audio controls include ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and color‑contrast support.

Which languages does text to speech support?

The free plan supports 32 languages. PRO unlocks 70+ languages and 600+ voices.

Does text to speech work with Elementor, Divi, or Gutenberg?

Yes. It integrates with all popular page builders and standard WordPress themes.

Can I bulk‑convert existing posts to audio?

Yes. Upgrade to PRO and use the Bulk Generate tool.

Will text to speech slow down my site?

No. The player is lazy‑loaded and cache compatible.

Can I use my own voice?

Yes. PRO users can enter their custom ElevenLabs Voice ID.

What happens when I run out of credits?

Existing audio remains playable. New audio will not generate until credits renew or you upgrade to PRO.

1.9.9 – 2026-02-03

  • Improved telemetry module architecture

1.9.8 – 2026-02-02

  • Fixed content extraction when theme wrapper classes (entry-content) are not in rendered HTML
  • Fallback extraction now runs when only specific element selectors match, capturing sibling paragraphs
  • Properly merges shortcode content (su-note) with surrounding article content

1.9.7 – 2026-02-02

  • Fixed content extraction stopping after nested div shortcodes (su_note, etc.)
  • Removed LIBXML_HTML_NOIMPLIED flag that caused DOM parsing issues with complex nested structures
  • Wrapped HTML in proper document structure for reliable DOM traversal

1.9.6 – 2026-02-02

  • Fixed content extraction stopping after shortcodes like [su_note] from Starter Templates
  • Improved DOM parsing to properly extract text from nested div structures
  • Simplified UTF-8 encoding handling using meta charset instead of wrapper elements

1.9.5 – 2026-02-02

  • Fixed content extraction stopping after shortcodes with special characters
  • Replaced deprecated mb_convert_encoding() HTML-ENTITIES encoding with UTF-8 XML declaration
  • Improved DOM parsing compatibility with PHP 8.2+ for shortcode output containing em-dashes, smart quotes, and non-breaking spaces
  • Added LIBXML_NOERROR and LIBXML_NOWARNING flags for cleaner DOM parsing

1.9.4 – 2026-02-01

  • Added Credit Usage by Post tracking in My Stats page
  • Added generation history with total credits, last usage, and model columns
  • Fixed S3 upload for PRO multi-language audio generation
  • Fixed audio URL not saving correctly for frontend player
  • Improved stats display with 3-column grid layout

1.9.3 – 2025-12-13

  • Fixed audio generation for Norwegian (nb/nn) and other languages
  • Added language code mapping from BCP 47 to ISO 639-1 for ElevenLabs API
  • Mapped Norwegian Bokmål (nb) and Nynorsk (nn) to ISO 639-1 code (no)
  • Added mappings for Hebrew (iw→he), Indonesian (in→id), and Yiddish (ji→yi)

1.9.2 – 2025-12-05

  • PRO Performance Fix – Eliminated ElevenLabs API calls on every page load
  • Cached API usage data for 6 hours
  • Proper handling of 429 rate limit responses
  • PRO license activation count now displays correctly
  • Updated PRO compatibility to 1.4.9

1.9.1 – 2025-12-04

  • Multi‑Language Audio Generation for Weglot
  • Fixed ElevenLabs API method call
  • Fixed Weglot CSS compatibility
  • Improved player border styling

1.9.0 – 2025-11-20

  • S3 delete support
  • Scheduled post audio generation
  • Player persistence bug fix
  • Excerpt injection fix
  • Progress bar color customization fix
sections.description:
Text to Speech plugin for WordPress with natural AI voices, accessibility features, and SEO benefits. Includes 10,000 free credits.

Add Text to Speech to WordPress in Seconds

Text to Speech (TTS) by Mementor transforms your written content into natural, human-like audio. It helps make your website accessible to everyone, from readers who prefer to listen, to users with visual impairments or learning differences.

Powered by ElevenLabs, this plugin delivers lifelike speech that sounds warm and engaging. No setup, API key, or coding required, just install and start converting your WordPress posts into audio instantly.

Adding text to speech increases time-on-page and user engagement, both of which can improve your SEO. The plugin is built with WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 and ADA accessibility standards in mind.

You also get Speech‑to‑Text (STT) features in PRO, perfect for transcription, captions, or converting podcasts and video to readable text.

Key Benefits

  • Instant setup – No API keys or external accounts required
  • Human-like AI voices powered by ElevenLabs
  • Automatic, mobile‑friendly audio player
  • Accessibility ready with ARIA labels and keyboard support
  • Improved engagement and SEO signals
  • 10,000 free text‑to‑speech characters on activation
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • Speech‑to‑Text (PRO) transcription

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Publish or update a post or page
  3. A text‑to‑speech audio player appears automatically
  4. Visitors can play, pause, or download the audio

Your site now speaks.

Video Walkthrough

Full walkthrough, features, and pricing:
https://mementor.no/en/wordpress-plugins/text-to-speech/

Why Choose This Text to Speech Plugin

Simple and Fast

No accounts, API keys, or coding needed. Install, activate, and start listening.

Natural AI Voices

Natural male, female, and multilingual voices that sound truly human.

Accessibility and Compliance

Fully compatible with WCAG 2.1 AA and ADA guidelines.

Theme and Page Builder Compatibility

Works with any theme or page builder, including Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Visual Composer, and all standard WordPress themes.

SEO Optimized

Audio players increase dwell time and improve accessibility signals. PRO includes AudioObject schema for enhanced search visibility.

Features

Free Features

  • 10,000 free characters to convert text to audio
  • Natural male and female voices in multiple languages
  • Automatic player for posts, pages, and WooCommerce products
  • Zero‑click install
  • Mobile‑first player with speed control and download
  • Accessibility ready with ARIA labels and keyboard control
  • Audio auto‑updates when post content changes
  • Statistics dashboard
  • Shortcode and block support
  • Content filtering with CSS selectors or no‑audio class
  • Optimized for caching and performance plugins
  • Multisite support

PRO Features

  • 75,000 characters per month
  • 600+ voices across 70+ languages
  • Premium 44.1 kHz audio quality
  • Speech‑to‑Text transcription
  • Bulk audio generation
  • WooCommerce product narration
  • Voice cloning with ElevenLabs Voice ID
  • Word replacement and pronunciation correction
  • SSML support
  • Custom pauses
  • AudioObject schema for SEO
  • Custom intro and outro
  • Amazon S3 media offload
  • Advanced analytics
  • White‑label mode
  • Priority support

Supported Languages

Compatible with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot, and other translation plugins.

Popular voices include English (US, UK, AU), Norwegian, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Japanese, and more.

Accessibility and SEO Advantages

  • Meet WCAG 2.1 AA and ADA requirements
  • Increase average session time
  • Assist users with dyslexia, ADHD, or visual impairments
  • Boost SEO with rich media and structured data
  • Create inclusive multilingual content

Use Cases

  • Accessibility and inclusion
  • Blogs and news
  • E‑commerce product descriptions
  • Education
  • Long‑form content
  • Multitaskers
  • Content creators

More Tools by Mementor

  • QR Code Generator for WordPress – https://qr-kode.no/en
  • Mementor Core – https://wordpress.org/plugins/mementor-core/
  • BestPris.no – https://bestpris.no/
  • SEO‑Analyse.no – https://seo-analyse.no/

Standard Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Text to Speech (TTS) by Mementor”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. You receive 10,000 free characters instantly
  5. Optional: connect your ElevenLabs account or upgrade to PRO
  6. Adjust settings in Settings → Text to Speech

Quick Start Guide

  • Automatic mode
  • Generator
  • My Stats
  • Player Settings
  • Content Rules
  • Analytics
  • Bulk Generation (PRO)

External Services

ElevenLabs API

Purpose: Converts your text into natural‑sounding speech
Data sent: Post text, voice ID, API key (if used)
When: On manual or automatic audio generation
Storage: MP3 files saved locally or on S3
Limits: Free tier 10,000 characters per month, PRO 75,000 characters per month
Terms: https://elevenlabs.io/terms-of-use
Privacy: https://elevenlabs.io/privacy-policy

Mementor Software Licensing (Lemon Squeezy)

Handles checkout and license validation for PRO
Terms: https://mementor.no/en/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy: https://mementor.no/en/privacy/
Buyer terms: https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/buyer-terms
Privacy: https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/privacy

Privacy

No personal data is collected by the plugin.
Only content text sent for speech synthesis is transmitted to ElevenLabs.
API keys are stored encrypted.
Audio files remain on your server or configured S3 storage.
Full data removal is performed on uninstall.

Credits

Natural voice synthesis by ElevenLabs
Developed by Mementor Webdesign & Digitalt Markedsføringsbyrå AS

This plugin includes an affiliate link to ElevenLabs. If you purchase through this link, Mementor may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you.
